DELIBERATE DISPUTE (§8, standing duty 8). basis: Palantir Technologies (NYSE: PLTR) is on 8vc.com/companies but no 8VC vehicle has ever held it. Joe Lonsdale co-founded it in 2003 — eight years before Formation 8 and twelve before 8VC — and the only Form D attributions are his own 2009 filings, which fall OUTSIDE his 8VC tenure (2016-2026) by seven years. Palantir has been public since September 2020, so a fund position would appear on a 13F: 8VC GP I, LLC's 13F-HRs report one holding, Joby Aviation. T2 (out where the only connection is a person) and T4 (whose money sat behind the seat). decisions.md D7.
